intro: FeralSpotter gather the following when you:
body: The app will only ever gather location data while you're using the app. Only photos that you select will be uploaded.
By continuing, you agree to photos and location being captured when you take a photo, and to all of this data being uploaded as described above.
declineWarningBody: Without permissions, you won't be able to use FeralSpotter.
locationOnceWarningBody: If you chose "Only this time" for location, Android revokes that access as soon as the app closes. Location may not be captured next time you open FeralSpotter until you grant access again.

analytics.title: Usage Data
analytics.intro: FeralSpotter is still a little feral. Anonymous usage data helps us improve your experience.
analytics.label: Anonymous usage analytics
analytics.text: such as app events and crash data, to help us improve FeralSpotter

emailOptIn.title: Stay in the loop?
emailOptIn.intro: We can send you news about FeralSpotter by email. This is optional.
emailOptIn.label: Email updates
emailOptIn.text: about FeralSpotter news and project updates, sent to the email address on your account. You can turn this off at any time in Settings.
